tooltip.better_whips.royal_slime_whip.le: A supple royal slime whip with about 8 blocks of attack reach. Faster contacting sections deal more damage.
tooltip.better_whips.royal_slime_whip.ri: Charge right click to slam the ground and release a wide shockwave.
tooltip.better_whips.royal_slime_whip.it: Consecutive hits increase attack speed, stacking up to 5 times.
tooltip.better_whips.leather_whip.left: A firm, direct leather whip with 1.6 attacks/sec and about 8.5 blocks of attack reach.
tooltip.better_whips.leather_whip.physic: Its stiffer lash has less rebound for fast, direct strikes.
tooltip.better_whips.leather_whip.damage: The contacting section deals 0.2 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of speed.
tooltip.better_whips.leather_whip.pet: Hitting an enemy makes nearby owned pets prioritize that target.
tooltip.better_whips.leather_whip.vfx: Friendly pets gain Speed; no-team or same-team players gain Haste.
tooltip.better_whips.chain_whip.left: A light chain whip made from small black-iron links, with 1.2 attacks/sec and about 8.9 blocks of attack reach.
tooltip.better_whips.chain_whip.physics: Short links keep it nimble and responsive with lower inertia; it is not described as heavy.
tooltip.better_whips.chain_whip.damage: The contacting section deals 0.6 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of speed.
tooltip.better_whips.whip.multi_hit: Within one lash, successive targets take 100% → 50% → 25% → half again.
tooltip.better_whips.golden_heavy_whip.l: A heavy golden whip with 0.6 attacks/sec and about 9.4 blocks of attack reach.
tooltip.better_whips.golden_heavy_whip.p: Its golden mass increases sag and slows startup/turning, but preserves much stronger momentum.
tooltip.better_whips.golden_heavy_whip.d: The contacting section deals 2 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of speed.
A segmented whip of linked diamond blades: light, keen-edged, and quick in the hand at 2.0 attacks/sec.
Flexible light-fibre joints let the blades fold and extend freely, carrying real inertia and rebound through every swing.
Each contacting diamond blade deals 0.7 damage for every full 10 blocks/sec of section speed.
Every 2nd hit releases bonus magic damage equal to 50% of that hit.
tooltip.better_whips.destruction_whip.le: Contains the power of destruction, firing lasers to eliminate nearby enemies.
A light long whip braided from resilient vines. Attack speed: 1.6/sec.
The contacting section deals 0.3 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of speed.
Cannot be crafted; breaking leaves has a 0.1% chance to drop it.
tooltip.better_whips.destruction_whip.da: Each contacting section deals 3 damage for every full 10 blocks/sec of section speed.
tooltip.better_whips.destruction_whip.fa: Each resolved hit in the same lash continues to fall off: 100% → 50% → 25% → halved thereafter.
On a damaging hit, scatter random leaf fragments equal to the actual damage rounded up.
tooltip.better_whips.emerald_whip.damage: Deals 0.5 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of section speed.
tooltip.better_whips.emerald_whip.passiv: Emerald Splash: every 4 damaging hits launch 4 homing emerald bolts.
tooltip.better_whips.amethyst_whip.damag: Deals 0.7 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of section speed.
tooltip.better_whips.amethyst_whip.passi: Crystal Shards: damaging hits create amethyst shards that deal extra magic damage on hit and landing.
tooltip.better_whips.trainer_whip.left: An upgraded leather training whip with 2.0 attacks/sec and about 8.1 blocks of physical length.
tooltip.better_whips.trainer_whip.physic: During a lash, only the root is driven toward the crosshair and its trajectory propagates progressively to the tip. Storage still follows the Leather Whip physical system, while all training support effects are raised by one level.
tooltip.better_whips.trainer_whip.damage: The contacting section deals 0.2 damage per complete 10 blocks/s of speed.
tooltip.better_whips.trainer_whip.pet: Enemy hits command nearby owned pets; friendly-pet hits grant Speed II/III and same-side player hits grant Haste II/III.
tooltip.better_whips.trainer_whip.master: Passive - Minion Master: hitting a friendly pet grants +40% damage and +40% maximum health for 4 seconds.
tooltip.better_whips.trainer_whip.vfx: Uses the reinforced trainer-whip impact effect.
tooltip.better_whips.lightning_whip.dama: Deals 0.5 lightning damage per complete 10 blocks/s of section speed.
tooltip.better_whips.lightning_whip.pass: Flashflow: the first direct hit can release up to 6 arc hops; each deals 10% damage and briefly stalls its target.
tooltip.better_whips.untamed_sea_whip.at: Five independent tails. Base damage 5; later tails on the same target halve successively and ignore hurt i-frames.
tooltip.better_whips.untamed_sea_whip.bl: Formless Blade: five-tail thrust, 2x damage. On hit, reduced follow-up tail damage is doubled for 4 s. 4 s cooldown.
tooltip.better_whips.untamed_sea_whip.pr: Water's Protection: triggers on damage; for 5 s each hit is reduced by 5/8/12 on Easy/Normal/Hard. 25 s cooldown.
tooltip.better_whips.lightning_whip.obta: Natural lightning during thunderstorms has a 0.5% chance to drop it.
tooltip.better_whips.untamed_sea_whip.ra: In rain or water: +35% attack speed.
advancement.better_whips.heaven_sent_pow: Pick up Thunderstorm, a weapon bestowed by natural lightning.
death.attack.better_whips.royal_slime_wh: %1$s was struck down by %2$s with a Royal Slime Whip
%1$s was struck down by a Royal Slime Whip
command.better_whips.damage.enabled: Whip damage statistics enabled: each hit shows its damage and rolling 1-second DPS.
